basic_info.description: Spacious High Floor view condo at Opera Plaza with private view balcony! Large rooms with excellent closet space. Big views of City Hall and Downtown San Francisco. Opera Plaza is a well managed complex with numerous amenities including 24 hour private security staff, on site management, heated pool and spa, concierge, fitness center, racquet courts and more! On-site optional leased parking. Best central San Francisco location is on transit line and close to freeways.
